note: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines: nationals of Antigua and Barbuda, Barbados, Belize, Dominica, Grenada, Saint Kitts and Nevis and Saint Lucia move freely (Barbados, Belize and Dominica since 1 October 2025); nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 6 months, and every other passport for 3 months (extendable for a fee, not modelled), except those of Afghanistan, Cameroon, China, the Dominican Republic, Haiti, Iran, Iraq, Lebanon, Nigeria, Palestine and Syria, which need a visa beforehand (EC$200). Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Ministry of National Security's own page, which names the countries whose nationals must apply for a visa (Afghanistan, Cameroon, China, the Dominican Republic, Haiti, Iran, Iraq, Lebanon, Nigeria and Syria, EC$200): it doesn't name Palestine, which Wikipedia's copy, read before, had among them, so Palestine was moved to the 3 months every other passport has. The page gives no lengths and doesn't speak of the OECS's free movement: those stand on Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
sources.said: Holders of passports of the following countries may enter Saint Vincent and the Grenadines without a visa for the following period: Freedom of movement Antigua and Barbuda Barbados Belize Dominica Grenada Saint Kitts and Nevis Saint Lucia 6 months All European Union member states (except Ireland) Bahamas Guyana Iceland Jamaica Liechtenstein Norway Suriname Switzerland Trinidad and Tobago United Kingdom United States ... Citizens of other countries and territories may enter Saint Vincent and the Grenadines without a visa for up to 3 months, which can be extended for a fee. ... Citizens of the following countries and territories must obtain a visa prior to arrival. A fee of EC$200.00 is required to obtain a visa. Afghanistan Cameroon China Dominican Republic Haiti Iran Iraq Lebanon Nigeria Palestine Syria ... Complete Freedom of Movement in Four CARICOM Territories

sources.title: Ministry of National Security, St Vincent and the Grenadines: Entry Visa Application Form (Visa Requirements for St. Vincent and The Grenadines)
sources.said: Visa Requirements for St. Vincent and The Grenadines Persons from the named countries must apply to the Ministry of National Security in St. Vincent and the Grenadines, namely: Afghanistan, Cameroon, China, Dominican Republic, Haiti, Iran, Iraq, Lebanon, Nigeria and Syria. ... All applications require a non-refundable fee of EC$200.00 (US$88.00) .
